1620.name: EASTER KIDS NIGHT OUT! | March 27 | Friday | 7:00pm-9:30pm
1620.description:
EASTER EGGSTRAVAGANZA - Kids Night Out 

Time: 7:00pm - 9:30pm

Ages: 5+

Price: $40

Take the night off while we keep your kids entertained with nonstop fun! At Kids' Night Out, we'll have open play, games, gymnastics, crafts, and a pizza dinner! Each Kids' Night Out has an exciting theme, keeping the kids engaged while you enjoy a night out.

What To Wear: Come dressed in comfortable clothes.  NO shoes in the gym.

What to Bring: Make sure you bring a water bottle.

1572.name: HISD Spring Break Camp 2026| Mar. 16-20 | 9AM - 3PM
1572.description:
SCHOOL'S OUT AND WE HAVE A CAMP FOR THAT!

THERE WILL BE GYMNASTICS PLUS GAMES, CONTESTS, CRAFT, MOVIE, SNACKS

$250.00 for 5 full day camp (Monday-Friday) or $62 a day

  • Ages 5- 12
  • $62 For One Day
  • Complementary 8:30am Early Drop Off Available.
  • $20/day  3pm-5:30pm for After Care (Please Sign Up Separately).
  • Individual Day Registration Available!

Camp Details:

  • Camp is Non-refundable.
  • Bring a lunch from home.
  • Campers will be separated into groups based on age and ability.
  • Gymnastics campers should wear a leotard or tight-fitting shirt that covers their belly, and shorts or leggings.
  • Must bring water bottle – labeled with the camper’s name on it.
  • Must pre-register & pre-pay.

All camps are subject to minimum enrollment requirements. Rowland Ballard reserves the right to modify or cancel camp sessions if minimum enrollment is not maintained. In the event of a cancellation, registered families will be notified promptly.
